name: Akimoto Aoi
source:
A nurse at the Kamihori Clinic.
If she had never met Kisaku, she would probably have lived a happy life. Like Nadeshiko, she is a pink angel who will fall for a single glimpse of her underwear.
Perhaps because of a bad experience she had in the past, she will launch a suicide attack if treated improperly.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040616154153/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku4.html]the game's website, archived[/url]]
